_note: Closed source lists per lane. Agents may only search and fetch these domains; subdomains of a listed domain are allowed. Locked after the Tavily check of 2026-10-18: every domain here returned results and its page text could be extracted (apnews.com and ieeexplore.ieee.org only with advanced extraction, which the adapter retries automatically). Dropped because their pages could not be extracted or returned nothing: reuters.com, bbc.com, theguardian.com, railjournal.com, competition-cases.ec.europa.eu, worldwide.espacenet.com, insolvenzbekanntmachungen.de. Known gaps: EU competition cases and German insolvency notices have no source yet. Thin pages in the check (under 3,000 characters): tagesschau.de, handelsblatt.com, openalex.org.

news.description: Adverse media and industry news. Open-access outlets only, because paywalled pages cannot be stored for quote verification.

company.description: What the company says about itself, plus registers that identify it. The company's own website is added at run time after entity resolution (one domain per run).

legal.description: Sanctions lists, enforcement and competition cases, courts and insolvency notices. Primary sources only.

science.description: Safety, quality and technical evidence: rail accident and safety authorities, patents and papers.
